rationale_bullets: Browne returns as the settled, publicly endorsed starter: all 12 starts (first Purdue QB since Blough '16), 69.1 PFF/418 dropbacks (B10 +1 -> 70.1, ~p45 tape), 2,153 @ 59% with 9 TD/10 INT - 'dead last on the Big Ten QB Rating leaderboard' (P6).

The in-season split is documented: 'his first six games were noticeably better than his final six, perhaps due to a shoulder injury he took in the seventh game' (P6); yr 2 in Henson's system is the continuity case, and Odom: 'I believe in Ryan Browne.'
The depth is unproven: Singleton (69.9/75) left for App State; Chuba (no tape), Meredith (1 start L3Y), G. Odom, true FR Berry battle for QB2 (PS).
44, M: a full-volume returning starter whose adjusted tape sits just under the p50 reference but whose ratio/rating outcomes and empty QB2 room hold the grade below the MSU-53/Northwestern-52 tier.

The return case: Morrissette (the pre-'25 WR1) is back from a season-long injury with zero '25 tape, and TE Burhenn (67.3/61; 4 games) 'could be special' if healthy (Athlon) with Fox (UCF) behind him.
Magwood's yr4 return override is registered on a PS-only print (58.9/22) - depth impact only, LOW confidence.
